definition: An ordered list of numbers, called terms, where $u_{n}$ stands for the $n$th term.
A sequence in which you add the same number each time to get from one term to the next.
The fixed amount $d$ added to each term of an arithmetic sequence to get the next one, so $d = u_{n+1} - u_{n}$.
The sum of the terms of a sequence; $S_{n}$ stands for the sum of the first $n$ terms.
A short way to write a sum with the symbol $\sum$, giving the general term and the first and last values of a counter.
Interest worked out each period on the original amount only, so the same sum is added every period.
